text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, while on our way back<n>to the
academy, Shinko Windy and I<n>pass through the
shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mgh? That's a big crowd. What's<n>going on?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you<n>by! Get a ticket
now and spin for your<n>chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ya hear that, lackey?! It's a raffle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, raffle man! I wanna try!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's the spirit! Have you<n>got a ticket?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What? I gotta have a ticket first?<n>Grrrr!
choice_data_list: Looks like we can get one if we buy something.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Really? Why didn't you say so<n>sooner?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: C'mon! Let's go shopping!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I'm gonna win something<n>good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our newly acquired ticket in<n>hand, Shinko
Windy strides right up to<n>the raffle machine and
spins the<n>lever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh yeah!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Yes! Yes! I did it! I won the best<n>prize on offer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Which means we get to go to a hot<n>spring, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Sweet! Huge baths, scrumptious grub,<n>and comfy
futons will all be ours for<n>the taking! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for you and me...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C-c'mon, just look! It's got "pair"<n>written on it right
here! I can't go<n>alone!
choice_data_list: Isn't there anyone else you want to invite?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter with you?! I need<n>a personal
porter to carry my<n>suitcases!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The dastardly Windy doesn't go<n>around handing
out free vacations! A<n>lackey to do my bidding is all I
need!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So, you better prepare yourself. You'll<n>have to prep
my bags, navigate, then<n>put everything away once
we've<n>returned! Capisce?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Shinko Windy shoves the<n>hot spring ticket
into my hand.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Lose it and ya get chomped!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We're going once my schedule<n>opens up! Got
that?!
choice_data_list: Are you really sure you want me to come?
Are you really sure you want me to come?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Are you asking 'cause you don't<n>wanna?
choice_data_list: No, that's not it! I'd love to go!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heheeeh! ♪ Then we're going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up holding onto the<n>ticket for the hot
spring vacation. This<n>could be a nice reward for her
after<n>she reaches that lofty goal of hers!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Now that's a tasty lookingpiece of meat right there! Drool...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to feel hungry just<n>lookin' at it! Let's
race back to the<n>academy so I can eat it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We visit another shop to buy salad,<n>some rice balls,
and dessert, then<n>return to my office to eat together.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this smells amazing! Where's<n>the knife?
Hurry up and slice it in half<n>already!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Come to Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP! Munch, munch... Mmmm!Th-this is...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Just how I like it! Tough and chewy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You know! It's real thick and meaty,<n>so your jaw's
gotta do some work.<n>And the taste is pure and
simple.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The carrots weren't overboiled either,<n>leavin' them
with just the right<n>amount of sweetness while still
stayin' firm. It's perfect! Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Reminds me of how Mom makes<n>'em! Hers are
much tastier, though!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make a mental note of Shinko<n>Windy's culinary
preferences while<n>the two of us enjoy a laid-back
dinner together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, just look at 'em all! That's a<n>pretty
generous second prize if you<n>ask me.
choice_data_list: It might as well be all-you-can-eat.
It might as well be all-you-can-eat.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can eat my heart out...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! There's too many to just<n>eat 'em all. That
would be wasteful!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mwahahaha! Oh, the pranks I can pull<n>with these!
choice_data_list: Wh-what are you going to do?!
Wh-what are you going to do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Coming... There's no one here?<n>That's odd... Huh?
What's this?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What?! Well I'll be! A carrot! Who's<n>the angel that
left me such a sweet<n>surprise?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Windy! I know it's you! The<n>carrot-dropping
ding-dong ditcher!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I don't have a clue what<n>you're talking
about. I'm innocent!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I discovered one in my<n>locker as well. It
was a truly<n>incarrotable moment.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoooa! President, ya actually<n>noticed?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You hadn't said anything so I thought<n>you missed it
since I put it waaaay in<n>the—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bleeeegh! I'm just pullin' your leg!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, normally this mischievous<n>behavior of yours
would warrant a<n>terse reprimanding.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, but this time, you're<n>brightening
everyone's day. Thank<n>you so much for sharing,
Windy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! Whatcha thankin' me for?! I<n>told you, I
dunno what you're talkin'<n>about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... she's so stubborn. Is<n>sharing with others
really so<n>embarrassing?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: How 'bout that?! I got 'em all real<n>good, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Everybody's talking about<n>the mysterious
Carrot Phantom of<n>Miho Dormitory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is absolutely beaming.<n>Seeing that
her prank made everyone<n>happy this time, I breathe
a small sigh<n>of relief.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A carrot... Just a carrot?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it... but only to make up for<n>the shopping we
had to do.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This... makes things... even... I guess...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Graaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy suddenly sinks her<n>teeth into the
carrot's head and<n>ferociously chomps away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Serves you right, carrot!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A wild animal's what I am! What you<n>saw were my
feral instincts takin'<n>over!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Plus, that carrot had to pay the price<n>for
disappointin' me! It had the<n>unfortunate fate of
becomin' my<n>prey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She nods to herself in satisfaction. I<n>hope she can
keep up the appetite<n>moving forward and grow
healthy<n>and strong.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ya gotta be kiddin'... Tissues?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrr! This sucks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I wanted somethin' I could actually<n>celebrate about!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrrrrngh! It's time to ditch this sorry<n>spot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy drags her feet in the<n>direction of the
academy.
